correctness.rationale: Six simple branch points iff t != 0 and t^4 != 12 prove genus four. The matrix from the cited complete-intersection coefficient formula is independently reconstructed in two exact programs. Its determinant is -8t^6(t^4-6)(t^4-7), its lower-right nonzero entry fixes ranks one or two, and prime-field representatives t=7,9 have rank-one, nonnilpotent blocks. Fourth-root isomorphisms transfer stable rank to all eight geometric roots. Both independent exact programs completed successfully. No finite sampling is used as a proof of the universal geometric claim.

value.rationale: The fixed supersingular j=1728 quotient and equivariant conic pencil give a natural six-branch-point family, not an arbitrarily chosen cutoff. The exact arithmetic degeneration from (19-rank,a)=(2,2) to (1,3) on precisely eight simple smooth fibers gives a complete rank-stratum intersection and the two symmetry orbits, a reusable small-field benchmark for Prym and bielliptic moduli investigations.
